question_text: Were there any tracked objects (by object_id) that were detected at Gate_MainEntrance AND also at KeynoteHall_DoorA on 2025-12-08? If so, how many unique objects appeared at both locations?
answer_text: There were 1,596 unique objects detected at both Gate_MainEntrance and KeynoteHall_DoorA on 2025-12-08.

citations.cypher:
MATCH (e1:Event)-[:DETECTED_BY]->(:Camera)-[:LOCATED_AT]->(:Location {name: 'Gate_MainEntrance'})
WHERE e1.timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND e1.timestamp_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
WITH e1.object_id AS object_id
MATCH (e2:Event {object_id: object_id})-[:DETECTED_BY]->(:Camera)-[:LOCATED_AT]->(:Location {name: 'KeynoteHall_DoorA'})
WHERE e2.timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND e2.timestamp_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
RETURN count(DISTINCT object_id) AS unique_objects_at_both_locations
